purpose: Historical archive of explicitly completed/closed cancer studies. Not loaded by the patient-facing finder.
policy: Full merged records are retained here to prevent accidental re-addition. On-hold and needs-reconfirmation studies stay in the working catalog.

records.title: Paccal Vet chemotherapy after splenectomy for canine splenic hemangiosarcoma
records.funding: Fully funded: study diagnostics, treatment and examinations are covered.
records.notes: Stage I or II splenic HSA; first Paccal Vet dose must be possible within 30 days of splenectomy; prior chemotherapy excludes enrollment. Sponsor Vivesto announced June 26, 2026 that recruitment to the canine splenic-HSA pilot was complete.

records.center: ELIAS Animal Health / University of Missouri
records.contact: ELIAS Animal Health / University of Missouri Veterinary Health Center
records.title: ECI vaccine-enhanced adoptive T-cell therapy combined with chemotherapy for canine osteosarcoma
records.why: ELIAS Animal Health's current clinical-studies page explicitly says enrollment is open for ECI combined with chemotherapy.
records.intervention: Amputation, one to four chemotherapy doses, then ECI autologous vaccine-enhanced adoptive cell immunotherapy
records.funding: ⚪ Unfunded. No financial assistance is provided for participation in this study.
records.notes: Newly diagnosed appendicular OSA. Prospective open-label study; follow-up continues for survival/response. ECI is USDA-licensed for canine osteosarcoma.

records.title: Toceranib phosphate for metastatic or recurrent canine insulinoma
records.status: Ongoing — listed for Netherlands and United Kingdom in current ESVONC overview
records.contacts: Floryne Buishand — see Oncowaf/ESVONC current trial listing
records.funding: Confirm study-covered costs with participating center.
records.notes: Prospective evaluation of palliative and adjuvant toceranib phosphate therapy for metastatic or recurrent insulinoma; multicenter availability includes Netherlands and UK.

records.title: BG34-200 plus immunotherapy for canine malignant melanoma
records.status: Suspended on current Tufts Clinical Trials page
records.why: Tufts' live current-trials roster lists this new cancer immunotherapy study as a recruiting canine oncology trial.
records.intervention: BG34-200 cancer immune therapy plus immunotherapy
records.funding: Protocol-specific financial support; confirm with Tufts Clinical Trials Office
records.notes: New on the current Tufts roster. Exact measurable-disease, stage, prior-treatment and washout criteria should be confirmed from the consent/prescreen before classifying an individual dog as Likely.

records.title: Focused ultrasound ablation for spontaneous canine and feline tumors — Cyprus
records.center: University of Nicosia / Cyprus University of Technology
records.status: Recent therapeutic pilot completed; continuation/recruitment not publicly confirmed
records.contacts: Dr Kyriakos Spanoudes / FUS research team
records.funding: FUSVET supported by Cyprus Research and Innovation Foundation; current coverage unknown.
records.notes: 2025 pilot treated 15 dogs/cats with spontaneous tumors using focused ultrasound and demonstrated targeted ablation. Current owner recruitment was not found; watch/contact lead only.

records.title: FLUOROCOXIB A optical imaging tracer in dogs with naturally occurring bladder cancer
records.contacts: Nora Springer, DVM, PhD, DACVP — nspringer@utk.edu · UTCVM 865-974-8387
records.funding: Contact study team for study-covered diagnostics/procedures.
records.notes: Current UTCVM active trial evaluating a new optical imaging tracer in dogs with naturally occurring bladder cancer; diagnostic/imaging research, not anticancer treatment.

records.title: Genetic landscape of acute myeloid leukemia in dogs
records.contacts: Nora Springer, DVM, PhD, DACVP — nspringer@utk.edu · UTCVM 865-974-8387
records.funding: No cost to participate; study pays for flow cytometry confirmation and tumor-cell gene sequencing.
records.notes: Blood and mouth-swab genomic study for dogs with acute leukemia; remote participation is possible if treatment at UTCVM is not desired. This is not an experimental treatment.
